observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides a relaxed, encouraging, and culturally-grounded introduction to the dance. She emphasizes the importance of feeling the music and connecting with the earth through the movements.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces herself and the dance style, Sega, from Mauritius.
The teacher breaks down the three main components of the dance: grounded movement, travel, and the basic roll.
The teacher explains the footwork, emphasizing that the choice of leading leg is flexible.
The teacher focuses on hip movement, instructing students to loosen their hips and bend their knees.
The teacher introduces the shuffle step and explains how to incorporate upper body movement.
The teacher explains the cultural significance of the dance as a community activity and the role of hand gestures.
The teacher performs the dance to music, demonstrating the steps in a continuous flow.

extraction.counting_scheme: the teacher does not use a formal counting scheme, instead f
cues: arms and your hands are free
metaphors: little me pats on the surface
common_mistakes: putting too much weight on the front leg
keeping the top part of the body still
safety: do not bend the knees too low to avoid it becoming a workout

steps_taught.name: Grounded movement
steps_taught.description: A step where the dancer maintains a connection with the ground.

steps_taught.name: Travel step
steps_taught.description: A step involving moving across the floor with one heel raised.

steps_taught.name: Basic roll
steps_taught.description: A hip movement that involves a seesaw motion.

steps_taught.name: Shuffle
steps_taught.description: A step where the back foot is lifted and the dancer moves.

what_works: The teacher's relaxed and encouraging tone
The clear breakdown of the three main components
The emphasis on feeling the music rather than strict counting
what_hinders: The lack of a formal counting scheme might be difficult for some learners
The camera angle changes can be slightly disorienting

quotes.text: Little me pats on the surface, okay? So connect with the earth.
Your knees have to be bent. Feel awkward in the beginning.
Sega is a community dance, you know? When we dance with each other.
You shouldn't really need to bob because the bending in the knees.
Bouze means move. It means dance.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher explains the three components of the dance while standing in a neutral position.
The teacher turns around to demonstrate the step from a different angle.
The teacher lifts her back heel to demonstrate the preparation for travel.
The teacher demonstrates the hip movement while keeping her knees bent.
The teacher demonstrates the arm movements for the female dancer.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher emphasizes the cultural and community aspect of the dance, using the language and the concept of 'ambiance' to explain the dance's purpose.
